story.title: AI Startups Face Lower Margins Than SaaS Era, Kalaari Capital Urges Founders to Prove Unit Economics
story.summary: Kalaari Capital's Harshit Kumar has warned that AI-native startups in India face structurally lower gross margins than traditional SaaS companies due to rising inference costs and the expense of human review processes. He argues that Indian AI founders must prioritise building defensible moats and demonstrating measurable customer ROI rather than relying on growth metrics alone. The advice signals a maturing in investor expectations as the AI startup funding cycle moves from enthusiasm to scrutiny.
